entities.name: Aether Collection Towers
entities.description: Huge spires on Avishkar that funnel aether from the sky into cables running to the Aether Spire in Ghirapur.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Continent where the aether-gathering machinery is found.

entities.name: Aether Spire
entities.description: Prominent Consulate headquarters in Ghirapur and former site of Tezzeret's secret laboratory; both a collection tower and a distribution hub.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: City where the Aether Spire stands.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker whose secret laboratory was once in the Aether Spire.

entities.name: Aether Hub
entities.description: The largest aether distribution center on Avishkar.

entities.name: Aetherflux Reservoir
entities.description: Giant storage unit for aether collected from the towers.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The governing body that uses the towers to make aether accessible; its symbol was inspired by the towers.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: Rebels who claim the Consulate's aether infrastructure is a stranglehold; they use the Leaking Spire symbol.

entities.name: Avaati Vya
entities.description: Discoverer of aether refining processes sixty years earlier.

events.summary: Rebellious forces claim the Consulate's aether infrastructure is a stranglehold on a freely available resource, and try to undo its work.
events.quote: some rebellious forces claimed that the infrastructure and regulations amounted to a stranglehold on what should be a freely available resource

events.summary: The towers become a symbol of the Consulate's tyranny and inspire the Consulate's symbol and the Renegades' Leaking Spire symbol.
events.quote: The Aether Collection Towers became seen as a symbol of the consulate's tyranny

relations.quote: some rebellious forces claimed that the infrastructure and regulations amounted to a stranglehold
absorbed into cables running to the Aether Spire in Ghirapur
